scope: Feature 011 local synthetic server workload only
decisionSource: technical-selection.json; owner authorization permits this bounded engineering procedure, not a gate disposition

repeatProcedure.databaseIsolation: Each invocation runs the existing harness separately on both runtimes; each allergy/content phase creates a random harness-owned database from template0, applies setup, and drops/verifies exact database absence in finally cleanup.
wrapperTransformations: Remap runner relative imports to their source file URLs so the retained temporary execution copy can live in ignored artifacts.
Replace only the runner's single K23 proof directory declaration with the unique run-01, run-02, or run-03 K24 destination; preserve surrounding bytes/newline style.
Record exact before/after substitutions and original/transformed source hashes. The helper refuses existing run outputs and writes logs/source/manifest with exclusive-create semantics.
repeatProcedure.correctnessHandling: Keep all source assertions, setup assertions, HTTP status assertions, cleanup checks, counters and 400/800 ms thresholds unchanged. Preserve every completed threshold miss. A setup/assertion failure before proof creation stops later repeats and remains recorded as failure.

workload.topology: Windows host -> Fastify inject -> native Supabase Auth HTTP loopback -> non-owner PostgreSQL pool -> Docker PostgreSQL
workload.network: Loopback only; no WAN, RTT, bandwidth, loss, or region emulation
workload.arrivalModel: Serial completion-driven; each next request follows completion and fixture preparation
workload.duration: Observed per complete run; no fixed sustained-load interval or throughput claim
workload.warmupAndOrder: For each runtime, allergy loop is 3 warmup iterations followed by 20 measured iterations; each iteration measures createAllergy, verifyAllergy, listAllergies in order. Then the content loop uses 3 warmup iterations followed by 20 measured iterations; each measures createClinicalContentRelease, two signClinicalContentRelease calls, publishClinicalContentRelease, and listClinicalContent, in that order. No cache flush is performed.

syntheticInputs.allergyReport: The exact report object in the bound source, compact JSON UTF-8 serialization: 170 bytes; report contains synthetic-neutral test substance and bilingual synthetic self-report display strings.

canonicalContentMaterials.interpretation: Raw fixture material byte lengths; request carries material evidence references and does not directly carry these material byte strings.

syntheticInputs.allergyDataset: Per runtime, 23 report iterations are created (3 warmup + 20 measured); verification and reads are also exercised. Exact durable count fields are captured by each proof after execution.
syntheticInputs.contentDataset: Per runtime, 23 successive synthetic past-effective releases, each admitted and signed twice, are created (3 warmup + 20 measured); publication and narrow governance reads are exercised. Exact durable count fields are captured by each proof after execution.

workload.localEvidenceAndCrypto: No production vendor or KMS. Real local application AES and synthetic private evidence/admission sources are exercised.

instrumentation.clock: performance.now around each application request callback; setup and explicit private fixture provisioning between requests are outside that request timer.
instrumentation.inRequestControl: Private synthetic provenance/support lookup can use owner Docker psql during request execution and is included in elapsed request time; the runner documents this test-control overhead.
instrumentation.correctness: Expected HTTP status per measured operation; exact harness setup/cleanup and source pin checks; externalUnderLocks must be 0 for each runtime; proof retains dataset snapshots/counts and raw samples.

workload.percentile: Nearest-rank: sorted samples at index ceil(0.95*n)-1; for n=20 this is the 19th sorted sample, and for signing n=40 this is the 38th.
workload.targetAuthority: Existing NFR-PERF-002; targets remain unchanged, and each operation is evaluated in each run on both runtimes.
workload.cacheState: Warmup then measured samples; cache is not flushed, so this is not cold-cache evidence.
